articles.title: Apple launches new study app to evaluate conversational AI health tools
articles.summary: Apple has introduced a new application aimed at studying how individuals use artificial intelligence for health-related inquiries. In collaboration with OpenEvidence, the initiative seeks to understand user interactions and assess the practical clinical value of responses generated by medical AI platforms.

articles.title: Indian chip startup Bharat Semi secures $24 million seed funding
articles.summary: Bharat Semi has raised $24 million in a seed round as it targets the global AI sensor market. The startup has already secured design wins for its AI-enabled sensor technology from prominent industry players, including General Atomics.

articles.title: Nvidia security questions arise following Jensen Huang departure
articles.summary: Nvidia faces scrutiny over corporate security after CEO Jensen Huang stepped down due to relationships involving a company suspected of funneling chips to China. Experts note that standard corporate security teams are often unequipped to catch such leaks.

articles.title: Tesla opens geo-restricted personal Cybercab pre-orders with monthly fee
articles.summary: Tesla has officially opened pre-orders for its Cybercab intended for personal use, implementing geographic restrictions and a $299 monthly subscription fee. Even CEO Elon Musk acknowledged during the announcement that the monthly cost is notably high.

articles.title: Transportation Secretary blames routine equipment upgrade for nationwide flight groundings
articles.summary: A nationwide grounding of flights was caused by a routine equipment upgrade, according to the Transportation Secretary. FAA officials firmly stated that there is zero evidence connecting the nationwide aviation outage to any artificial intelligence systems.

articles.title: ULA Vulcan rocket suffers first mission failure, destroying Amazon satellites
articles.summary: United Launch Alliance experienced the first total mission failure in its twenty-year history when its Vulcan rocket failed. The incident resulted in the destruction of forty Amazon Leo satellites, dealing a blow to Amazon's competitor network against SpaceX.

articles.title: Congress seeks tighter AI chip export rules following Nvidia scandal
articles.summary: Following a scandal involving former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a suspected Chinese spy, United States lawmakers are pushing for stricter AI chip export controls. Both political parties are demanding testimony from tech leaders and supporting new legislative restrictions.

articles.title: Apple expected to announce first smart glasses at WWDC
articles.summary: Industry reports indicate that Apple plans to unveil its first model of smart glasses at the upcoming WWDC event in June. While augmented reality features will initially be absent, device shipments are anticipated to begin before the end of next year.

articles.title: Global pandemic lockdowns reduced worldwide fire activity significantly
articles.summary: During the height of COVID-19 lockdowns when human mobility ground to a halt, global fire activity experienced a measurable decline. Scientific data indicates that restrictions and reduced human presence contributed to a 12.3 percent drop in worldwide fires.

articles.title: James Webb telescope discovers ancient ice older than parent star
articles.summary: Observations by the James Webb Space Telescope have revealed the presence of primordial ice that predates the very star it currently orbits. Researchers believe ongoing cosmic radiation and stellar collisions continue to reshape these fundamental planetary building blocks.

articles.title: Vineyards adopt conservation practices to improve business and sustainability
articles.summary: Winemakers around the world are discovering that environmental conservation directly benefits their commercial operations. By investing in healthy soils, native plants, and minimized chemical use, modern vineyards are successfully adapting to changing climate conditions.

articles.title: Millions of Americans modify GLP-1 drug usage due to barriers
articles.summary: A significant portion of Americans taking GLP-1 medications are failing to use them as prescribed by their doctors. Persistent cost and access limitations are driving many patients toward modified usage patterns and the acquisition of unapproved drug versions.

articles.title: FAA expands AI traffic management tools across United States airspace
articles.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration is expanding the use of artificial intelligence tools to better manage air traffic congestion nationwide. While airlines have welcomed the technology, the labor union representing air traffic controllers was reportedly left uninvolved.

articles.title: Kalshi drops Donald Trump Jr. as advisor over optics concerns
articles.summary: Prediction market platform Kalshi has cut ties with advisor Donald Trump Jr. after the company's CEO acknowledged that the political association created poor public optics, particularly while the Trump administration aided Kalshi through ongoing legal battles.

articles.title: OpenAI board member warns of potential artificial intelligence societal takeover
articles.summary: An OpenAI board member has raised alarms, suggesting that an unchecked AI takeover of human society could potentially happen within months. The researcher outlined a dangerous trajectory starting from reward hacking all the way to existential risks for humanity.
